name: Sorcerer Aberrant Lord
body:
The descendants of the most improbable monsters bear in their blood the potential to unlock the strangest and most diverse powers.

Strange Bloodline

An aberrant lord must have the aberrant or shapechanger bloodline.

Aberrant Heritage

At 1st level, an aberrant lord chooses an alien heritage (see In The Company of Aberrations by Rite Publishing). Whenever he would gain a bloodline power, he may instead take an alien heritage power. At 1st level, the 1st-level power can be chosen; at 3rd level, the 3rd-level power; at 9th level, the 7th-level power; at 15th level, the 11th-level power; and at 20th level, the 17th-level power. This modifies the sorcerer’s bloodline powers.

The Bardess’ Library #12: Bloodlines, © 2025, Legendary Games; Author: Margherita Tramontano.
